name: Python Programming Fundamentals
description: Learn Python syntax, variables, data types, functions, loops, and basic problem solving.

name: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Learn arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, searching, sorting, and algorithmic thinking.

name: SQL and Database Fundamentals
description: Learn relational databases, SQL queries, joins, filtering, aggregation, and database design.

name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Learn supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, preprocessing, and common ML algorithms.

name: Deep Learning with Neural Networks
description: Learn neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, training techniques, and deep learning workflows.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Learn text preprocessing, embeddings, sentiment analysis, transformers, and language-model concepts.

name: Web Development Fundamentals
description: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, and fundamental web development concepts.

name: React.js Development
description: Build modern frontend applications using React, components, state, props, hooks, and APIs.

name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
description: Learn cloud concepts, compute, storage, networking, deployment, and basic AWS services.

name: Generative AI and LLMs
description: Learn large language models, prompting, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI applications.
